descriptionChirho: Guidance or recommendation given by a person to another, the ordinary sense of counsel or advice in interpersonal contexts.
A determined intention or purpose, often referring to God's sovereign plan or a deliberate scheme that will be carried out.
Plural counsels or deliberations, often with a negative connotation referring to devious schemes, plots, or machinations.
A person who gives counsel; participial usage of the root denoting one who advises.
